_comment: services: raw API ServiceType string -> slug. Two ServiceType strings that share a slug are treated as the SAME service by gtfs_parallel.py (e.g. 'NON AC SLEEPER' and 'PALLAKKI (NON AC SLEEPER)' are just different branding for the same product, so both map to slug PALLAKKI). labels: slug -> human-readable name used in route long_name. A ServiceType not listed here falls back to an auto-generated slug/label at runtime (see _service_slug in gtfs_parallel.py) — add it here once reviewed.
